# Mix Two

Mix Two is a fork of Mixxx. It replaces rekordbox 6 for a DJ with a Pioneer
DDJ-800. The text below shows the status of the work, up to 2026-11-24.

## Overview

Each area holds the features for one part of the work. Fill is the part
of the features that is complete. In an area marked "Deck test", a
feature is complete only when the owner tests it on the DDJ-800.

## Activity

The latest changes, newest first.

- 2026-11-24: small tempo buttons use rekordbox's steps; one script runs all export judges (commit: see git log, "Tempo: the small tempo buttons use rekordbox's steps for the tempo range" and "tools: export_verify.py runs all export judges on a stick")
- 2026-11-23: channel effect units are not heard on the headphone CUE (commit: see git log, "Engine: channel effect units are not heard on the headphone CUE")
- 2026-11-18: DDJ-800 TEMPO slider uses rekordbox's steps; SHIFT + BEAT LOOP pad does nothing (commit: see git log, "DDJ-800 mapping: TEMPO slider uses rekordbox's steps; SHIFT + BEAT LOOP pad does nothing" and "DDJ-800 mapping: TEMPO slider ends are exact for every range; sampler bank helper does not write")
- 2026-11-18: DDJ-800 sampler pads use slots 1-8 and 9-16 of one shared bank; Beat FX selector order pinned by a test (commit: see git log, "DDJ-800 mapping: sampler pads use slots 1-8 and 9-16 of one shared bank" and "test: Beat FX selector order of the DDJ-800 is pinned")
- 2026-11-18: DDJ-800 mixer strip waits for pickup after a deck change (commit: see git log, "DDJ-800 mapping: soft takeover for the mixer strip after a deck change" and "DDJ-800 mapping: pickup sees a control that jumped over the value")
- 2026-11-18: in-app text wording pass for STE (commit: see git log, "In-app text: wording pass for Simplified Technical English" and "In-app text: two more strings in STE")
- 2026-11-18: Sound Color FX buttons on the screen locked for on/off while the DDJ-800 is connected (commit: see git log, "Sound Color FX buttons: no on/off by click while the DDJ-800 is connected")
- 2026-11-18: Beat FX list unlocked again, Beat FX on/off locked to the DDJ-800 (commit: see git log, "Skin: Beat FX list free again, on/off locked to the DDJ-800")
- 2026-11-18: Beat FX effect list locked while the DDJ-800 is connected (commit: see git log, "Skin: Beat FX list locked while the DDJ-800 is connected")
- 2026-11-18: STE word check script for the text that the user reads (commit: see git log, "tools: STE word check for the text that the user reads")
- 2026-11-18: DDJ-800 mapping comments match the code, option text in STE (commit: see git log, "DDJ-800 mapping: header comments match the code, option text in plain technical English")
- 2026-11-13: 3Band waveform tuned and seen on screen; zoomed waveform / 3Band programme state (commit: see git log, "Waveform: 3Band band gains fitted to rekordbox's band balance")

# Mixxx

[![GitHub latest tag](https://img.shields.io/github/tag/mixxxdj/mixxx.svg)](https://mixxx.org/download)
[![Packaging status](https://repology.org/badge/tiny-repos/mixxx.svg)](https://repology.org/metapackage/mixxx/versions)
[![Build status](https://github.com/mixxxdj/mixxx/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/mixxxdj/mixxx/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![Coverage status](https://coveralls.io/repos/github/mixxxdj/mixxx/badge.svg)](https://coveralls.io/github/mixxxdj/mixxx)
[![Zulip chat](https://img.shields.io/badge/zulip-join_chat-brightgreen.svg)](https://mixxx.zulipchat.com)
[![Donate](https://img.shields.io/opencollective/all/mixxx?label=Donate)](https://mixxx.org/donate)

[Mixxx] is Free DJ software that gives you everything you need to perform live
DJ mixes. Mixxx works on GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS.

## Quick Start

To get started with Mixxx:

1. For live use, [download the latest stable version][download-stable].
2. For experimentation and testing, [download a development release][download-testing].
3. To live on the bleeding edge, clone the repo: `git clone https://github.com/mixxxdj/mixxx.git`

## Bug tracker

The Mixxx team uses [Github Issues][issues] to manage Mixxx development.

Have a bug or feature request? [File a bug on Github][fileabug].

Want to get involved in Mixxx development? Assign yourself a bug from the [easy
bug list][easybugs] and get started!

## Building Mixxx

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for build instructions, code style
guidelines, and how to open a pull request.

## Documentation

For help using Mixxx, there are a variety of options:

- [Mixxx manual][manual]
- [Mixxx wiki][wiki]
- [Hardware Compatibility]
- [Creating Skins]

## Translation

Help to spread Mixxx with translations into more languages, as well as to update and ensure the accuracy of existing translations.

- [Help translate content]
- [Mixxx i18n wiki]
- [Mixxx localization forum]
- [Mixxx glossary]

## Community

Mixxx is a vibrant community of hackers, DJs and artists. To keep track of
development and community news:

- Chat with us on [Zulip][zulip].
- Follow us on [Mastodon], [Bluesky] and [Facebook].
- Subscribe to the [Mixxx Blog][blog].
- Post on the [Mixxx forums][discourse].

## License

Mixxx is released under the GPLv2. See the LICENSE file for a full copy of the
license.
